summary: Splits captured geometry into primitive groups by shared bone influence and rewrites capture attributes into per-bone-group pCaptData/pCaptPath sets.

key_params.name: bonesperpoint
key_params.note: Maximum number of bone influences kept per point

key_params.name: bonespergroup
key_params.note: Maximum bones allowed per primitive bone group before creating another group

common_gotchas: Modern well-authored models often do not need Bone Group SOP; use it only when splitting captured geometry for material/deform workflows.
Original pCaptData and pCaptPath are deleted and replaced with numbered pCaptData0/pCaptPath0 style detail attributes.
After grouping, isolate primitive groups with Delete SOP and point deform-aware MATs at the matching numbered capture attributes.
key_concepts: Bone Group SOP groups captured primitives by the bone influences they share.
The operator rewrites capture data into numbered pCaptData and pCaptPath detail attributes and numbered pCapt vertex attributes.
Primitive groups such as boneGroup0 and boneGroup1 can then be isolated for material or deform workflows.
Capture weights are renormalized after grouping, and modern well-authored models often do not need this operator.
